WITH equipment_avg_humidity AS (
  SELECT 
    equipref,
    AVG(humepct) as avg_humidity
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY equipref
),
overall_avg_humidity AS (
  SELECT AVG(humepct) as overall_avg
  FROM scanenvironment
  WHERE humepct IS NOT NULL
),
above_average_equipment AS (
  SELECT 
    e.equipref,
    e.avg_humidity,
    o.overall_avg
  FROM equipment_avg_humidity e
  CROSS JOIN overall_avg_humidity o
  WHERE e.avg_humidity > o.overall_avg
),
group_mean AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) as group_mean
  FROM above_average_equipment
)
SELECT 
  a.equipref,
  a.avg_humidity,
  a.avg_humidity - a.overall_avg as exceeds_all_equipment_avg,
  a.avg_humidity - g.group_mean as diff_from_group_mean
FROM above_average_equipment a
CROSS JOIN group_mean g
WHERE a.avg_humidity IS NOT NULL
  AND g.group_mean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY a.avg_humidity - g.group_mean DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;
